en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until mid-afternoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Thunderstorm Warning at 12.55pm, later extended, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 12.55pm on Monday and subsequently extended its validity to 4.15pm, warning of isolated thunderstorms over Hong Kong.
The Observatory said the public should take precautions if outdoors, seek shelter in a safe place, stay away from water and avoid high ground or conductive objects such as trees and poles.

Local temperatures in the early afternoon ranged from the high 20s to low 30s Celsius under mainly cloudy skies with intermittent sunshine and scattered showers. A hot weather special advisory remained in effect.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午中段
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時55分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間至下午4時15分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台於星期一中午12時55分發出雷暴警告，其後將有效時間延長至下午4時15分，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台提醒市民，如身處室外，請到安全地方躲避；離開水面，切勿進行戶外水上活動；切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
下午初段本港氣溫介乎二十多度至三十度初，大致多雲，間中有陽光及幾陣驟雨。炎熱天氣特別提示仍然生效。
